findings: Both production implementations were reviewed. Complete-line command trials now cover many recovered cases: the original833 improve to549 passing and all36 earlier parse failures disappear. This does not close the grammar or authorize packet acceptance.

Fresh tests show lost native classes after group-note/braced-note rejection, root record/struct misdispatch, visibility-prefixed ordinary packages rejected, and qualified named-note codes rejected. Existing TIM/theme valid inputs acquire five new parse errors. Every failure and all62 maker cases are preserved below.

The parser has no new fixture-label dispatch or shipping golden lookup, but a successful subset and fallback score still do not implement PSystemBuilder factory order over the complete supported command grammar. Four mixed-description kinds parse yet paint as class boxes.
